about: The opener LLM Warming song (operator 2026-10-16: "from the LLM warm template, make the opener LLM Warming song"): Wire-Pod plays it at every start, in place of its built-in opener (settings llm.opener_song_id; no song folder = the built-in one). Played by Wire-Pod (gopod_opener_song.go), not by pha0b. Notes: warm_message (the System llm bubble's message, shown and said; "wait_voices": true waits for the voice files before it's said), warm_wait (waits until the language model is loaded), llm_song (this folder's _llm_song run: the lines between \"Voices ready\" and \"LLM ready\"; swap the _llm_song folder to change them, no steps = nothing said), warm_ready (the ready message, shown and said), sting (the system sting, settings reporter_voices.system_stings.default). Every step: "volume": "" (chat_audio.volume, the master) or a percentage of it ("50%"), on its voices and stings (operator 2026-10-16: "add volume, default or %age").
